gaps.explanation: No business-type detail lines. The proprietary funds statement (p6, printed p11) prints five enterprise columns (Water Fund, Sewer Fund, Electric Fund, Storm Water Fund, Solid Waste Fund; the Internal Service Fund column is excluded). The JSON business-type receipts are the Total Enterprise Funds operating revenue rows plus Investment earnings (20,690,341 + 231,405 = 20,921,746). Added one line per non-zero cell of those rows. Column totals as printed: Water 4,637,668 + 70,633; Sewer 8,877,659 + 130,090; Electric 4,282,510 + 10,160; Storm Water 387,557 + 5,129; Solid Waste 2,504,947 + 15,393. Row checks: Charges for services 4,113,043 + 7,665,348 + 2,471,617 = 14,250,008; Fees, taxes, permits and licenses 209,710 + 35,574 + 362,764 + 1,200 = 609,248; Sales tax 32,964 + 1,151,871 + 24,793 = 1,209,628; Miscellaneous 250,500 + 24,866 + 32,130 = 307,496; Investment earnings 70,633 + 130,090 + 10,160 + 5,129 + 15,393 = 231,405. Sum of added lines 20,921,746 = statement 20,921,746 (0 + 20,921,746).
